profile.name: NAT Global Campus
profile.description:
Welcome to Niel Asher Education's YouTube channel — a trusted global resource for continuing education for massage therapists, continuing education for physical therapists, manual therapists, athletic trainers, and rehabilitation professionals.

Our channel features expert-led tutorials, clinical demonstrations, interviews, and educational insights designed to support professional development and real-world practice. Topics include manual therapy, sports rehabilitation, soft-tissue techniques, movement science, pain management, assessment, and integrative approaches to care.

Whether you are completing continuing education for massage therapists, advancing your skills as a physical or manual therapist, fulfilling continuing education for athletic trainers, or growing as a rehabilitation professional, our content supports lifelong learning and clinical excellence.

Niel Asher Education is known worldwide for high-quality instruction, trusted educators, and accessible online education.

reasons.text: 频道简介自称提供面向按摩治疗师、物理治疗师等的继续教育，主题包括手法治疗与软组织技术。
视频标题提到“Unleash the Power of Massage and Trigger Point Therapy for Your Horse's Well-being”，涉及马匹按摩与触发点治疗。
视频标题提到“In-Depth Equine Massage: A Step-by-Step Guide to Hindquarters Techniques”，简介描述“Equine therapy, encompassing a range of therapeutic activities involving horses”，涉及马匹治疗。
视频标题提到“Leda Mox: Equine Massage, Stretching, and Longevity”，简介描述其为马匹护理与治疗专家。

cautions: 频道主体为人类按摩/物理治疗继续教育，马匹内容仅为其中一部分；简介中的认证与课程资质未独立核实。
这是基于公开元数据的初筛，角色为推断，尚未完成背景调研。
